fields.description: The target SQL Server type (the SqlDbType each variant's constructor passes to SqlParameterMapAttribute or CollectionMapAttributeBase) and the CLR property shapes its IsValidType override accepts, for the 24 MapToSql*Attribute variants (23 scalar SqlParameterMapAttribute subclasses plus MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute). Nullable forms are accepted only where listed; enum acceptance is limited to the string-family and integer variants (not Binary/VarBinary). Integer attributes (BigInt, Int, SmallInt, TinyInt) accept both signed and unsigned/opposite-signed 64/32/16/8-bit integers via unchecked same-width bitwise conversion, while Binary and VarBinary attributes also accept ulong, uint, ushort, sbyte (and their nullable forms) via fixed-width big-endian binary encoding. Every accepted scalar shape works through input parameters, output parameters, data-reader reads and table-valued-parameter rows; any unsupported CLR shape is rejected with InvalidMapTypeException when the mapping is first built, while a supported binary numeric shape with an incompatible configured length is rejected with InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException.

members.description: byte[] (no nullable wrapper; ReadOnlySpan<byte>, Span<byte>, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> and Memory<byte> are rejected), or ulong, uint, ushort, sbyte, ulong?, uint?, ushort?, sbyte? (enums are NOT accepted). Numeric values are encoded as fixed-width big-endian bytes (8B for ulong, 4B for uint, 2B for ushort, 1B unchecked((byte)value) for sbyte), which preserves unsigned sort order in SQL Server for ulong, uint, and ushort (not sbyte). Configured length must be -1 (varbinary(max)) or in [width, 8000], otherwise IsValidType throws InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException; on read/output decode, a non-null payload whose byte length != width throws InvalidBinaryValueLengthException.
members.name: VarBinary

members.description: byte[], or ulong, uint, ushort, sbyte, ulong?, uint?, ushort?, sbyte? (enums are NOT accepted). Numeric values are encoded as fixed-width big-endian bytes (8B for ulong, 4B for uint, 2B for ushort, 1B unchecked((byte)value) for sbyte), preserving unsigned sort order for ulong, uint, and ushort (not sbyte). Configured length must equal the exact byte width of the numeric type (8, 4, 2, or 1), otherwise IsValidType throws InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException; on read/output decode, a non-null payload whose byte length != width throws InvalidBinaryValueLengthException.

fields.name: MapToSql*Attribute target-type matrix

representations.CSharp: Each scalar member is realized by a MapToSql<member>Attribute subclass of SqlParameterMapAttribute, and TableValuedParameter is realized by MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute : CollectionMapAttributeBase. Although MapToSqlBigIntAttribute, MapToSqlIntAttribute, MapToSqlSmallIntAttribute, MapToSqlTinyIntAttribute, MapToSqlBinaryAttribute, and MapToSqlVarBinaryAttribute support ulong, uint, ushort, and sbyte (and their nullable forms) for ordinary model properties, ShardKey<...> does NOT support unsigned (ulong, uint, ushort) or sbyte record/child/grandchild/great-grandchild key type arguments: ShardKeySerialization.GetKeyDataType returns KeyDataType.Undefined for those types, so ShardKey constructors throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException.
